history.name: samuelgursky/davinci-resolve-mcp
history.summary: Retrieves complete Resolve 21.1 transcripts with segment text, timestamps, speakers and optional word timings; retains the 21.0 clip-property fallback.
changes: Retrieves complete Resolve 21.1 transcripts with segment text, timestamps, speakers and optional word timings; retains the 21.0 clip-property fallback.
Restores timeline marks after a single-frame capture and corrects relative versus absolute frame offsets.
Provider marks the 21.1 transcript API as reported, not exercised on its test machine.

history.name: samuelgursky/davinci-resolve-mcp
history.summary: Updates Node and Python dependency manifests and removes unused uuid dependency. Provider reports remaining transitive advisories.
changes: Aligns the root and advanced Node dependency manifests with updated MCP SDK, XML, ZIP, image, schema, YAML and PostgreSQL libraries.
Removes the unused uuid dependency; retains better-sqlite3 11.x.
Raises the Python MCP SDK minimum to 1.30 while retaining the below-2 cap; raises pyaaf2 to 1.7.1.
Provider reports unchanged Resolve behavior and five remaining transitive Node dependency advisories.

history.name: DaVinci Resolve MCP
history.summary: Broader safe-mode coverage and consistent destructive-action classifications.
changes: Classifies all 108 registered destructive actions and expands safe-mode blocking to 35 high or critical actions.
Recognizes source-clip deletion and external camera-sidecar modification risks.
Separates assessed medium-risk actions from unrated operations.
Isolates saved user preferences in tests and adds guards for complete risk classification and consistent inspection/gating.

history.name: samuelgursky/davinci-resolve-mcp
history.summary: Corrects granular-tool risk ratings and audit outcomes in the latest release.
changes: Aligns 20 granular-tool classifications with the compound-server assessments.
Raises destructive clip deletion to critical risk and grade copying/scene-cut detection to high risk.
Distinguishes pending confirmation from completed operations and records failed calls.
